subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is 'drew.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence "***Perhaps the memories of his boyhood days, when he ___(2)___ the familiar scenes of his birthplace***...'' is telling something about the memories of Pasteur's boyhood days.
 
• The given sentence is talking about **the childhood days or about a past action**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'drew', a past tense form of the verb.
 
• The word 'drew' means **to do a picture or diagram of something with a pencil, pen, etc. but not paint**. 
 
 
• Example:* The artist **drew** the scene from memory*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete Sentence: *Perhaps the memories of his boyhood days, when he drew the familiar scenes of his birthplace...*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us explore the other options:

__
 
• 'Drawn' is an adjective that means **looking tired, worried, or ill**. (थका, चिंतित या बीमार-सा, लटका हुआ)
 
• 'Draw' is the base form of the verb. ('Draw' क्रिया का मूल रूप है)
 
• 'Draws' is the third-person present singular form of the verb. ('Draws' क्रिया का third-person present singular रूप है)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य "*Perhaps the memories of his boyhood days, when he ___(2)___ the familiar scenes of his birthplace*...'' पाश्चर के बचपन के दिनों की यादों के बारे में कुछ बता रहा है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **बचपन के दिनों या पिछली कार्रवाई के बारे में बात कर रहा है**।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द '**drew**' है, जो **क्रिया का भूतकाल** का रूप है।
 
• शब्द 'drew' का अर्थ है **किसी का चित्र या आरेख बनाना**। 
 
 
• उदाहरण: *The artist drew the scene from memory*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है ।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *Perhaps the memories of his boyhood days, when he drew the familiar scenes of his birthplace...*
